messages:
Megan (CFO): Quick heads-up — finance guidance for the rest of Q2: effective immediately, please pause any new vendor subscriptions or one-off purchases unless they are essential. We are seeing infra + cloud overage and need to re-align spend vs. runway. Details + exception process here: https://docs.redwood.ai/finance/q2-spend-guidance (internal) :link:

Patrick (Finance Ops): To clarify, 'essential' = customer-facing production infra, payroll, security/compliance, and pre-approved renewals. Anything else needs a purchase request and a finance sign-off.

Patrick (Finance Ops): New vendor request form: https://forms.redwood.ai/vendor-request — pick 'expedite' only with manager + finance approval.

procurement-bot: Reminder: open POs older than 30 days will be reviewed. Current flagged POs: #9876, #9921.

Priya (People Ops): :eyes: Hiring queues are unaffected for approved headcount. If you need contractor subscriptions for interviewing or candidate tools, route them through people-ops and note hiring tag.

Alex (Eng): quick q — can I renew FigJam annual plan ($420)? Manager approved.

Patrick (Finance Ops): If it's under $500 and has manager sign-off, go ahead. Please add it to the vendor form so we have a record.

Jordan (Eng): We have an outstanding order for a monitoring add-on ($2,400). Do we submit the existing PR or wait for the review?

Megan (CFO): Submit the PR and tag @Patrick — we'll triage. If it's production-critical, include 'production SLO impact' in the justification so it gets expedited.

Alex (Eng): Also — can procurement-bot route security-tagged requests to me and Megan automatically? We've seen delays on urgent fixes.

procurement-bot: New workflow added — requests with 'security' or 'prod-slo' tags now auto-notify Megan (CFO) and Patrick (Finance Ops). See changelog: https://docs.redwood.ai/finance/procurement-changelog

Patrick (Finance Ops): Reminder: all company card charges must have receipts uploaded within 7 days or they'll be auto-reconciled and flagged for follow-up. This helps close the month faster.

Jordan (Eng): Got it — will upload receipts for last month's charges today.

Megan (CFO): We'll revisit department quotas at the finance sync next Tue 9am PT. If your team needs an exception, DM Patrick with the business case. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
